Settings_ExcelIncludeSourceQuery.en: Include content of attached query-window on its own sheet (hold Shift to do the opposite)
Settings_ExcelIncludeSourceQuery.zh: 在单独工作表中包含所附查询窗口的内容（按住 Shift 则相反）

Settings_ExcelAddAutoFilter.en: Add filter dropdowns to header row (AutoFilter)
Settings_ExcelAddAutoFilter.zh: 在标题行添加筛选下拉（AutoFilter）

Settings_ExcelBlankFilename.en: Leave blank → DataExport__{yyyyMMdd__HHmmss}.xlsx; use {...} for date-wildcards
Settings_ExcelBlankFilename.zh: 留空 → DataExport__{yyyyMMdd__HHmmss}.xlsx；使用 {...} 作为日期通配符

Settings_GoogleAuthPrefix.en: Authorize AxialSqlTools to create Google Sheets using an OAuth client ID from
Settings_GoogleAuthPrefix.zh: 授权 AxialSqlTools 使用来自

Settings_GoogleAuthSuffix.zh: 的 OAuth 客户端 ID 创建 Google 表格。

Settings_CheckUpdatesOnStartup.en: Check for Axial SQL Tools updates on startup
Settings_CheckUpdatesOnStartup.zh: 启动时检查 Axial SQL Tools 更新

Settings_ConnectionColorsDesc.en: Color query window status bars and document tabs based on the server and/or database name. If both fields are filled, both must match. Leave a field empty to match anything.
Settings_ConnectionColorsDesc.zh: 根据服务器和/或数据库名称给查询窗口状态栏和文档选项卡着色。如果两个字段都填写，则必须同时匹配。留空字段可匹配任意值。

Settings_ConnectionColorsExamples.en: Examples: Server='PROD' matches SQL-PROD-01. Database='master' matches any connection to master. Server='PROD' + Database='Sales' matches only Sales on PROD servers. First matching rule wins.
Settings_ConnectionColorsExamples.zh: 示例：Server='PROD' 匹配 SQL-PROD-01。Database='master' 匹配任何连接到 master 的连接。Server='PROD' + Database='Sales' 仅匹配 PROD 服务器上的 Sales。第一条匹配的规则生效。
